# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current: stock
> Strata v0.2.1 (engine 0.1.46) + stock OMP 18.10.1 on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
> IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock layer split, pipeline windows 2 and 8 GiB conversation parking,
> no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090; `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with stock setup's batch slots, parking and 32K chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)),
> and on an RTX 5090 at 131,072 tokens (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)).
> Qualified opt-in by the owner on 2026-10-21: RTX 5090 Coder IQ1_M at 262,144 tokens
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json)),
> with a 36 GiB available-RAM startup floor, 21 pass and 3 not applicable. The 131K profile remains the RTX 5090's
> current/default; this is an explicit opt-in.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> The PRO and RTX 5090 roll back to v0.1.44.1 + OMP 18.10.1, with the same models and stock setup choices:
> [PRO, 262K](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.1.44.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 131K](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.44.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 262K opt-in](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.1.44.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json).
> The pair rolls back to [v0.1.43.1 + OMP 18.10.1](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-parking-strata0.1.43.1-omp18.10.1/qualification.json);
> its v0.1.44.1 release remains draft, not qualified (layers 0-44 / 45-47 split regression).
> Each current ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable. Real-host receipts cite `3f52b65` on the PRO, RTX 5090 131K and
> pair main runs; G17 reruns cite `13cbdbe` (PRO, RTX 5090 131K; the 131K G18 rerun too) and `fa0f88a` (pair), and the
> RTX 5090 262K ran at `13cbdbe` (operator receipts G01-G05 cite `91f7b04`; host-free G06 cites `84a7843`). G17 failed on
> the PRO, RTX 5090 131K and pair main runs because since v0.2.0-beta stock's server shortens a one-token-over
> `max_tokens` to the room left instead of answering 400 (a prompt that alone leaves no room is still refused), passing
> on each rerun; G18 failed once on the RTX 5090 131K and passed on its same-root rerun. Both stay beside the newer
> passes. Scored (G24): PRO 17/18 (v0.1.44.1 rollback 15/18), RTX 5090 131K 17/18 (15/18), 262K opt-in 15/18 (15/18),
> pair 16/18 (v0.1.43.1 rollback 15/18). Pilot: 5/6 each. Per task: tool-loop 2/3 on PRO, RTX 5090 131K and pair, and
> 0/3 on RTX 5090 262K opt-in; pair multifile-regression 2/3; every other task 3/3. Protocol counters (malformed
> arguments etc.) are 0 across all four v0.2.1 profiles (v0.1.43.1 pair had 1); all task failures stay counted. Scored
> batch walls are 623 s on the PRO (v0.1.44.1: 496 s), 771 s on the RTX 5090 131K (703 s), 778 s on the 262K opt-in
> (760 s) and 1,051 s on the pair (v0.1.43.1: 1,047 s); these are not isolated decode latency. v0.2.1 ships its engine
> (0.1.46) as a separately versioned CUDA 13 component tarball staged into `runtime\strata\engine\`; model pins, stock
> setup plans, flags and floors stay unchanged.
> Owner decision on 2026-10-21: "Qualify PRO, 5090 131K, 262K opt-in and route" and, for the pair, "Qualify 0.2.1
> anyway". On `rtx3090-win-a`, v0.2.1's automatic layer split puts layers 0-24 on the RTX 4090 and 25-47 on the RTX
> 3090 (v0.1.43.1: 0-31 / 32-47; the unqualified v0.1.44.1: 0-44 / 45-47). Measured back to back on the same host,
> decode is 141-158 against 170-201 tok/s, prompt reading at 64K-100K tokens 2,838-2,853 against 3,508-3,594 tok/s, and
> 100K-token TTFT 36.0 s against 28.6 s; the owner accepted the slowdown and qualified v0.2.1 anyway, with v0.1.43.1 as
> rollback. The PRO and RTX 5090 v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, the pair's v0.1.43 profile, and each host's v0.1.42 +
> OMP 18.8.9 profiles stay earlier qualified history. All earlier failed gates and passing reruns remain published.
> The pair's [earlier qualified 131K profile](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-disp4090-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`, runs stock
  OMP 18.10.1 through an SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.1-omp18.10.1`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.1 262K profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-10-21 at `3f52b65`: health RTT 4.7-5.1 ms
  and stream TTFT 0.171 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall
  passed after tunnel reopen (0.81 s), client restart (0.68 s) and verified server restart (1.16 s).
  Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.1.44.1-omp18.10.1`, reaches the PRO's v0.1.44.1 262K rollback.
  The 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier
  history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands

- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects

- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
